draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the committed qualification draw at judge/private/final_cases.json unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance; every host that builds from this tree evaluates the same final suite, so raw scores are comparable across hosts for this instance
draw_policy.privacy: the frozen instance lives on the Judge-only path judge/private/, is staged mode 0600 into a root-only Judge build context, is never present in the Work image and is proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py; the build manifest records its SHA-256
draw_policy.redraw: scripts/generate_final_manifest.py --plan PLAN --redraw --seed <int> draws one reproducible 63-bit seed and one checked trial per case from a seeded random.Random (default seed: int.from_bytes(sha256("<suite_id>|<task_id>").digest()[:8], "big")); the cases come from the frozen Judge-only plan. A redraw is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded and no earlier score is comparable to it.
draw_policy.shapes: withheld: 138 cases on 15 deployed geometries (including per-rank tensor-parallel layouts) in four workload families; serving lengths are real request lengths; only the families, tiers, counts and weights are disclosed here

frozen_instance.provenance: v3 qualification draw 2026-11-07: the default seeded draw of scripts/generate_final_manifest.py (seed derived from the suite identity) over the frozen Judge-only suite plan

selection_semantics: all 162 cases execute; the 24 edge fixtures are zero-weight hard gates; the 138 scored rows are geometrically averaged within each of the batch, serving, long and real families and the score is the equal-weight geometric mean of the four family means; every decoy and edge call runs under the TileLang-only operator record
timeout_semantics: suite gates and orchestration ceilings qualify the selected execution profile; they do not identify a GPU model
